title: galactoPINNs
summary: Physics-informed neural networks for galactic potentials

highlight.alt: Orbits of a test particle in a Milky Way–LMC system, integrated in the true potential, a near-true analytic model, and three neural-network models. The most complete neural-network models track the true orbit almost exactly, while the near-true analytic model drifts away from it.
highlight.description: Physics-informed neural networks for galactic potentials, learning only the corrections to an analytic model from stellar kinematics.
